title: Pipe Statics for District Heating
description: Five video modules with knowledge checks: materials, pipe statics fundamentals and applications, flexible pipes and thermal insulation, civil works, welding and joints. Based on the BRUGG Pipes CAS course material on thermal networks.

modules.title: Materials
modules.description: Why district heating pipe is made of steel, and what that means for design.

modules.title: Pipe statics: fundamentals
modules.description: How a buried bonded pipe moves, and the limits that keep it safe.

modules.title: Pipe statics: applications
modules.description: Branches, flat bends, prestressing, twin pipe and bedding.

modules.title: Flexible pipes and thermal insulation
modules.description: CASAFLEX, CALPEX and the polyurethane foam that insulates them all.

modules.title: Civil works, welding and joints
modules.description: From route planning to the backfilled trench. Followed by the PREMANT installation video.

documents.title: Introduction to Pipe Statics in District Heating
documents.description: English translation of the BRUGG course script: fundamentals, permissible stresses, anchor point, expansion elements, pads, branches, changes of direction

documents.title: A Short Guide to Steel for District Heating
documents.description: English translation: properties, temperature, microstructure, P235GH, fatigue and aging
